user.title: Connect to your Dobiss NXT server
user.description: Enable the developer API in the NXT settings, then copy the API secret from that same page.

data_description.host: The address of the NXT server on your network, for example 192.168.1.10.
data_description.secret: Found under Settings, General, Developer API on the NXT server.
data_description.secure: Only needed when reaching the server over a cloud domain.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the API secret
reauth_confirm.description: The server at {host} no longer accepts the stored secret. It changes when the developer API is switched off and on again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the server at that address.
error.invalid_auth: The server rejected this secret. Check that the developer API is enabled.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the logs.

abort.already_configured: This Dobiss NXT server is already set up.
abort.wrong_server: That address belongs to a different Dobiss NXT server.

data_description.cover_mode: Basic reports only open or closed, and stays unknown after a partial run. Position keeps a running estimate and adds a slider, but needs the travel times below to be right.
data_description.cover_closetime: Used in basic mode. A run longer than this counts as a full travel, so the cover is at an end stop. Set it just below the shortest full run your covers make. Zero leaves every cover unknown.
data_description.cover_travel_up: How long the cover itself takes to travel end to end. This is not the time the Dobiss relay stays energised: a tubular motor stops at its own limit switch while the relay keeps running.
data_description.cover_travel_down: As above, for closing. Many covers close slightly faster than they open.
data_description.ignore_zigbee_devices: Skip devices that Dobiss proxies from Zigbee, if you already integrate them directly.
data_description.invert_binary_sensor: Turn on when your input contacts are wired the other way round.

covers.title: Cover travel times
covers.description: Pick the cover you want to give its own timings.

cover_times.title: Travel times for {cover}
cover_times.description: Time how long {cover} actually moves, from fully open to fully closed{mode_hint}.

options.position: Position: running estimate with a slider

turn_on.name: Turn on
turn_on.description: Switch a Dobiss output on, using the extras the Dobiss API offers: a delay handled by the server itself, a logical condition, or the motion-detector variant.

brightness_pct.name: Brightness
brightness_pct.description: Level for a dimmable output, as a percentage.

delay_on.name: Delay on
delay_on.description: Wait this long before switching on. Above 120 seconds the server rounds to whole minutes, up to two hours.

delay_off.name: Delay off
delay_off.description: Switch off again after this long. The countdown runs on the Dobiss server, so it survives a Home Assistant restart.

from_pir.name: From motion detector
from_pir.description: Send this as action 9, which restarts the motion timer inside Dobiss instead of switching the output the way a normal command does.

condition_id.name: Condition
condition_id.description: Id of a logical condition that the server checks before carrying the action out.

condition_state.name: Condition must be
condition_state.description: Whether the condition has to be true or false for the action to run.

action.name: Send action
action.description: Send a raw action to the Dobiss NXT server. For anything the entities do not cover.

address.name: Address
address.description: Module address, or an NXT element address above 200.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Module output, counting from zero, or NXT output number, counting from one.

option1.name: Option 1
option1.description: Dimmer level (0-100), audio volume, or a temperature setting.

option2.name: Option 2
option2.description: Dimmer soft start/stop, audio source, or a temperature period.

delay_off.name: Delay off
delay_off.description: Seconds after which to switch off again.

condition_id.name: Condition
condition_id.description: Id of the logical condition to check first.

condition_state.name: Condition must be
condition_state.description: Whether the condition has to be true or false.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Ask the server for a full status. Rarely needed: the server pushes every change on its own.
